draft.text: You came because your left knee feels unstable and sometimes gives out when you are walking, usually on flat ground and without warning.
We did not find any specific issues during the visit, but you are willing to have further tests to understand the cause.
Your knee giving out could be related to ligaments, meniscus, or other structures inside the knee joint.
You will have an orthopedic examination and imaging studies like an MRI or X-ray to check the stability and structure of your knee.
